findings.impact: The documented JSON/nonzero/no-traceback contract is violated for a small untrusted input; a parser recursion crash can be used as a denial-of-service input and is not reported as LIGHT_HANDOFF_INVALID.

reproduction.command: python -m video_paper_wiki_research knowledge import --workspace <.work/ws> --context deep-array.json --document deep-array.json
reproduction.stderr_tail: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while decoding a JSON array from a unicode string

findings.required_fix: Bound nesting before decode or catch RecursionError in _parse_library_json_object and map it to LIGHT_HANDOFF_INVALID; add a CLI regression asserting one JSON error object, nonzero exit and no stderr traceback.
findings.summary: A deeply nested but bounded JSON object escapes the CLI error envelope with RecursionError and a traceback.

findings.impact: The same documented JSON/nonzero/no-traceback contract fails for a valid JSON number exceeding the interpreter safety limit; callers receive no actionable JSON refusal.

reproduction.command: python -m video_paper_wiki_research knowledge import --workspace <.work/ws> --context big-int.json --document big-int.json
reproduction.stderr_tail: ValueError: Exceeds the limit (4300 digits) for integer string conversion: value has 5001 digits; use sys.set_int_max_str_digits() to increase the limit

findings.required_fix: Use a bounded parse_int or catch ValueError in _parse_library_json_object and map it to LIGHT_HANDOFF_INVALID; add a regression for the interpreter digit-limit case.
findings.summary: A JSON integer beyond Python 3.13 digit limits escapes the CLI error envelope with ValueError and a traceback.

non_findings: A 5000-level nested array reached the expected LIGHT_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE stub boundary without traceback, so the defect threshold is the unhandled 10000-level recursion case.
No ordinary malformed/unsafe path or JSON case in the synthetic matrix produced a defect.
